messages.text:
I purchased a DC08 miner and its not working at full cap····.  I have tried 3 pools and it reports only about 65Mh/s rates on all 3 sites.  f2pool, luckymonster and solopool.  I worked with the solopool team and was trying to see if it was on their end and that the difficulties set would maybe be the issue.  But the Hardware errors it is having is a bit too much and indicates that a chip or two are bad on this.  Here is the data for the attempts and the settings.  Setting the voltages to anything other than 2.55 would give it more HW errors.  Solopool has a minimum 2048 difficulty setting thats not documented.  
But in the end I find this does not work and has other issues too like NTP settings, so I would like a full refund as your company sent me a defective device.  Could you get that going so I can ship this back to you.
John
Handed to the team · Refund on a delivered unit needs a person; RMA filed with no label sent and no r

Hi John,

Thanks for the detail, the log lines and the voltage testing you did. Stock firmware, normal mode, 65 MH/s against 480 rated and roughly 40 hardware errors every seven minutes is a unit fault, and I'm not going to argue it with you.

I'm sorry you filed the RMA and heard nothing back. That silence is on us, and I can see no reply went out to you.

Your refund on order Shop···· is with Abel and Georges now, along with the return label for the DC08, and one of them is picking it up today. They'll confirm the amount and send the prepaid label to this address, so please don't ship anything until the label arrives. Your order carries the Diagnostics and 3-Month RMA cover, so you're fully covered here.

Sorry again for the run-around.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
